title: Long-time behavior with non-generic initial data
exact_target: Determine long-time behavior of integrable PDEs for exceptional initial data that produce singular scattering behavior.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 8000008 (AMR-079-0008). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Percy Deift, Some open problems in random matrix theory and the theory of integrable systems (2007), arXiv:0712.0849, Problem 8.

status_qualification: The generic-data results and exceptional-data examples in the original text remain context. One must cover the specified resonant cases rather than substitute the regular reflection-coefficient assumptions of the established method.
